name: gravewake-android
description: Capacitor wrapper that bundles the Gravewake web game offline for Android (playtest2b). Not published; Bill decides the package name, signing and the Play release.

scripts.apk:debug: node build-offline.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: node build-offline.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
